crossRefs.note: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place…
Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small…
Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set…
when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so it was well, then. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.
But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing…
“ ‘ “Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
“Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”
The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t…

translations.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
translations.bsb: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
translations.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
translations.asv: saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, and regarded not man:
